findings: The native source markers avoid reusing clamped performance.now results when no explicit start/end timestamp is supplied. This is not proof of negligible measurement error or observer cost.

Chromium inspector_time_stamp_event::Data unconditionally calls V8 CpuProfiler::CollectSample on the selected trace path; disabling the optional devtools.timeline.stack category does not remove this call. No claim is made about its measured CPU cost.
The conditional inequality d >= 41 epsilon is correct for equal observed p95, symmetric duration errors and no sampling uncertainty. Favorable unequal comparisons need their own bound.

The reviewed proposal preserves per-frame application work, matched run-level statistics, all evidence and the original 5% target; it explicitly treats native tracing as diagnostic until transfer/observer uncertainty is defensible.
Pinned Playwright public CDP/native tracing dispatcher rejects WebKit. No supported WebKit native Timeline collection path was demonstrated. Context tracing is not a substitute.
